component.name: HongXu
虹叙
component.summary: Text adventures and AI storytelling with diverse characters
多元人物与情感故事的文字冒险与 AI 叙事工坊

description.p: HongXu is a text adventure workshop for stories about diverse people and relationships. Play branching scripts offline, or connect a large language model of your choice and improvise a story with an AI director and characters.
虹叙是多元人物与情感故事的文字冒险与 AI 叙事工坊：离线游玩分支剧本，或接入你选择的大模型，让 AI 导演与角色陪你即兴共创。

ul.li: Branching scripts that play offline, and an AI director mode that writes the story with you
可离线游玩的分支剧本，以及与你共同书写剧情的 AI 导演模式
Create stories and characters by hand, or from a single sentence with AI
手动创建剧情与角色，或用一句话让 AI 生成
Saves, achievements, a story branch map and share codes for exchanging stories
存档、成就、剧情分支图，以及用分享码交换剧情
Liquid glass and Material themes, colour presets and a bundled Kai typeface
液态玻璃与 Material 主题、配色预设与内置楷体

description.p: The interface is in Simplified Chinese. Stories, saves and AI keys stay on your computer; story text is sent only to the AI service you configure. Adult content is optional and off until you enable it in settings.
界面为简体中文。剧情、存档与 AI 密钥只保存在本机，剧情文本只发送给你配置的 AI 服务。成人内容需在设置中手动开启。

Better keyboard and mouse support: a navigation rail on wide windows, Esc and the mouse back button go back, Enter sends, Ctrl + = / - / 0 zoom, and the window remembers its size. The interface is consistently Simplified Chinese, emoji display in colour on every system, and the app can be installed from Flathub.
更适合键盘鼠标：宽窗口左侧导航栏、Esc 与鼠标侧键返回、Enter 发送、Ctrl + = / - / 0 缩放、记住窗口大小；界面统一为简体中文；各系统上的 Emoji 均以彩色显示；支持通过 Flathub 安装。
Every built-in story pack is included, plus seven new stories covering a wider range of sexual orientations and gender identities.
补齐全部内置剧情包，新增 7 部覆盖更多性取向与性别身份的剧情。
